Installed film layer refers to the film that stays on the motorcycle, e-bike or scooter after application. The release liner is peeled away to expose the F1038 adhesive. How the four models differ

  • YN10D-M is a 100 m roll with a 100 µm clear double-matte installed film and a double-matte PET liner. It is supplied without a separate protective cover.

Where to use the film

The film is supplied in rolls for protecting painted and compatible smooth plastic parts from everyday scratches and scuffs. Common applications include motorcycle fuel tank panels, fairings, scooter body panels and e-bike covers. The original application guide illustrates urban riding, off-road riding, daily commuting and shop installation.

For a sample evaluation, tell us which panel you plan to wrap and whether you need a clear or matte finish. Check the sample on the intended surface so you can assess its appearance and adhesion before ordering rolls.

Introducing the YunNian Space Armor Series, the industry's ultimate evolution in Paint Protection Film. The core weakness of standard TPU is hydrolysis—the gradual breakdown of the material when exposed to high heat and humidity. APC technology provides a molecular shield that is virtually immune to hydrolysis, allowing us to offer an unprecedented 15-Year Global Warranty. If you are operating in tropical or high-humidity regions, this is the only film that guarantees performance without yellowing, cracking, or losing its adhesive integrity.

15-Year True Warranty

A bold commitment backed by German-standard quality control. No yellowing, no cracking, no peeling for a decade and a half.

96 GU Mirror Gloss

Engineered for maximum optical clarity, providing a high-definition mirror finish that enhances the factory paint's depth.

Unmatched Performance Metrics

  • Extreme Hydrolysis Resistance: Retains 89% physical strength even after a 10-week boiling water test.
  • SAE J2527 Weathering Standard: Verified stability with Delta E < 1.0 after 2500 hours of accelerated aging.
  • Instant Self-Healing: Advanced molecular memory restores surface smoothness within seconds of heat exposure.
  • Ashland Pressure Sensitive Glue: Ensures a secure bond without edge-lifting, yet remains cleanly removable.

Elevate your automotive protection standards with the YUNNIAN Embedded Coating Series. YunNian Premium Aliphatic TPU Paint Protection Film

Engineered for professional installers and wholesale buyers who demand verified raw materials and consistent performance. Every component is sourced from globally recognized suppliers — no substitutions.

Material Specifications

  • Substrate: Covestro Desmopan® UP Series 9190 Aliphatic TPU — exceptional clarity, UV stability, and long-term non-yellowing performance
  • Adhesive: Henkel automotive-grade adhesive — strong initial tack, clean removal, no residue
  • Coating: Carsoo (卡秀) thermal self-healing topcoat — available in Hydrophilic and Hydrophobic variants

Available Thickness

  • 7.5 mil — standard protection, flexible for complex curves
  • 8.5 mil — enhanced impact resistance, ideal for hoods and bumpers
  • 9.5 mil — maximum protection for high-impact zones

Coating Options

  • Hydrophilic: Water spreads evenly across the surface for a clean, streak-free finish — preferred for rainy climates
  • Hydrophobic: Water beads and rolls off instantly — superior dirt resistance and ease of maintenance

Key Performance Features

  • Self-healing at 60°C or under direct sunlight
  • Anti-yellowing, anti-stain, scratch resistant
  • High optical clarity — preserves original paint color
  • Warranty: 10 Years
